record_hint: Use the bard CLI: python3 <bard plugin root>/scripts/bard_cli.py record decision|impression|vision-review|reconcile|insight|read|song-delivery --json <file> (record status|digest|search show what is owed and what sisters said). Impressions need 400+ characters, 3+ sentences, facets (observed, works, concerns, feelings, next_actions), claims quoting exact tokens from the artifacts, and an upstream entry for every sister impression you took in. Songs reach sisters only through record song-delivery, citing the impressions they came from.
